WOODWORK — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
